The '''2017–18 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team''' represented [[West Virginia University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mountaineers were coached by [[Bob Huggins]], in his 11th season as WVU's head coach, and played their home games at the [[WVU Coliseum]] in [[Morgantown, West Virginia]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 26–11, 11–7 in Big 12 play to finish in a tie for second place. They defeated Baylor and [[2017–18 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2018 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] where they lost to [[2017–18 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 Murray State Racers men's basketball team|Murray State]] and [[2017–18 Marshall Thundering Herd men's basketball team|Marshall]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen,<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/sd-sp-ncaa-tournament-west-virginia-marshall-murray-state-20180316-story.html|title=West Virginia advances, now faces Marshall team that Huggins torched|first=Tod|last=Leonard|work=[[The San Diego Union-Tribune]]|date=March 16, 2018|access-date=February 6, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.herald-dispatch.com/sports/marshall_sports/mountaineers-win-94-71-end-herds-magical-run/article_b2845f26-4f4b-5ec9-b48f-a8b133159e00.html|title=Mountaineers win 94-71, end Herd's magical run|first=Rick|last=McCann|work=[[The Herald-Dispatch]]|date=March 19, 2018|access-date=February 6, 2024}}</ref> where they lost to [[2017–18 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.inquirer.com/philly/sports/colleges/villanova/villanova-west-virginia-basketball-final-score-march-madness-sweet-16-sagaba-konate-mikal-bridges-jalen-brunson-jevon-carter-20180323.html|title=Villanova outlasts West Virginia in Sweet 16, 90-78|first=Joe|last=Juliano|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=March 23, 2018|access-date=February 6, 2024}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2016–17 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|Mountaineers]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 28–9, 12–6 in [[2016–17 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in second place in conference. They defeated [[2016–17 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]] and [[2016–17 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2017 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] where they lost to [[2016–17 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 Bucknell Bison men's basketball team|Bucknell]] and [[2016–17 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]] before losing in the Sweet Sixteen to [[2016–17 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]].
